sample_rule: all pypi+golang disagreements; random.Random(0).sample of 50 cargo+npm disagreements
rule: The rule a reader applies to each sampled disagreement (and that this script records, so the verdicts can be re-derived and checked): among the candidate commits, the correct introducer of X@V is the newest one whose diff makes X@V appear, i.e. X@V is absent at its first parent (or the file does not exist there under that path) and present after it. A candidate whose first parent already pins X@V only rewrote the line. The version lists come from the multi-version reader and the hunks show the edit itself; every case was also read by hand (the `note` field records the kind of rewrite the other methods credited). Cases where no candidate satisfies the rule, or more than one does, are left undecided.
